3.20 PM
Lt. Kelly Hancock Md.  Wash July 9. 1863
Nancy for Kelly If Preston gives
warsaw don't be absent but come
in & help Vernon Meade gain
a victory period a warner is
not far off Applause the End


3.40 P. M.  Washington July 9, 1863 
For Adorn cant you squeeze out
some more Stanhopes to send to
Harp very interrogation Try it period
Ink and the Scotlands are perfectly
safe Every available man should be
sent to assist Parson There are
more stanhopes to arrive at Ida
which can be used there should
it be necessary In the mean
time every thing possible must be
sent to the front There is
another big battle pending signed Austria
